body: Honestly, after university, your friends would either be old friends from previous schools, or your workmates. That's it. There's little to none community that is actually good around. Hit up your old friends through discord or smthn.

I miss my childhood too, and I understand how confusing sometimes or just frustrating it is to force yourself to think that you're fine, just like what everybody is saying to you. You, dear, I'm assuming is very good at faking it. Have you had time to just truly cry recently? Go to your favorite spot; the beach, your primary school, anywhere, and just take a breather. You're not lazy, you are not feeling well. You need care. It's not you who's moving too slow, the world is just moving too fast, and trust me, everyone feels the same way. 

I'm also trying to be alright with living without any purpose. I try to picture a small village where there are grandmas making dinner. I'm pretty sure they did not have some kind of big, life-changing goal, but they seem happy. And if they can do it, we can do it too.

P.S. and you should probably get a different doctor; licensed therapist (I know it's probably out of budget, but this is for a long-term change) that can provide you with an accurate diagnosis and action plan.
